reviews.rationale: The packet neither establishes that incomplete understanding causes the claimed impossibility nor supplies a sufficiently broad security guarantee to refute it under the fair contextual reading. CaMeL and CONTINUITY challenge the reasoning through external enforcement, but their demonstrated properties and limitations do not settle this claim.
